_comment: Expectations for bench/src/xform.rs (transform-verify, plumb TODO 6). Each phase is one tile session over the buffer; W is tile loads and stores (it was a memcpy per tile); RW keeps the transform matrix in a tile (no reload per tile); the rotation is a mask with X a const generic (it was a div per tile). The defaults apply too: no call or vector spill in an innermost loop, no memset/memcpy.
